inputs.root_cause: IPYNB had no installed-wheel proof, and 3 tests asserting resolution from an installed location failed in the shared dev venv. Whether those were a product defect or an editable-install artifact was unresolved.
inputs.regression_tier: full IPYNB suite against installed wheels

execution_steps: 1. Built format_factory_core and format_factory_ipynb wheels from source.
2. Created an isolated venv outside the source tree and installed both wheels with --no-index --no-deps, then nbformat as the oracle.
3. Confirmed via importlib.util.find_spec BEFORE running anything that format_factory.ipynb resolves from site-packages, not the repository tree.
4. Ran the 3 residual namespace tests there: all 3 passed, establishing they are an editable-install artifact rather than a product defect.

5. Ran the full suite and hit a fresh collection error: test_obligation_corpus_integrity.py imports pyyaml, which was undeclared -- the identical defect class to the nbformat omission, invisible in the dev venv because it happens to have pyyaml.
6. Declared pyyaml>=6.0 in the ipynb test extra and re-ran: 424 passed, 0 failed.
tests_run: installed-env pytest (3 namespace selectors) -- 3 passed (dev venv: 3 failed)

evidence.new_defect_found: pyyaml undeclared in the ipynb test extra; found only because the proof ran in a clean environment
evidence.obligations_moved_note: Zero. A green suite against installed wheels is not obligation-bound proof; all 68 remain `partial` pending the proof_requirement audit.
